desc: Derive the Hall-condition reduction: for range length M and D = M-K, feasibility of K pairs is equivalent to max_{j in [L, R-D]} (nxt[j]-j) <= D, valid only when D >= ceil(M/2); answer = M - D.
Parse input: read N, array A (ascending), Q, and all (L,R) queries.
Compute h[j] = nxt[j]-j via two pointers with sentinel n for "no valid bottom".
Build a sparse table over h for O(1) range-max queries.
Per query: M=R-L+1, binary search smallest D in [ceil(M/2), M] with rangeMax(h, L, R-D) <= D, output M-D.
Verified against Sample Input 1 (2 3 1 0 5) and Sample Input 2 (0 0 0 0 2 6 0 1 1 0 0 0 3 5 0) — all public samples passed and the reduced condition re-derived by hand checks out.
